headline: Created 3 production-ready customer personas for Series B-D People Ops buyers with segment-specific messaging strategies
highlights: Maya Chen – Risk-averse Director of People Ops; primary concern: brand fidelity (90%); 40-50% conversion potential
James Rodriguez – Cost-conscious VP People Ops; primary concern: unit economics & time ROI; 30-40% conversion, high LTV
Sarah Kapoor – Experience-driven Head of Ops; primary concern: culture impact & design partnership; 35-45% conversion, highest LTV
Comparative analysis: decision drivers, timelines, willingness to pay, objection handling, engagement preferences
Segment-specific messaging framework: distinct positioning for each persona with proof points and objection counters
Sample discovery questions mapped to each persona to validate fit during calls
GTM implementation guide: email subject line customization, demo mechanics by persona, refresh cadence

args.filter_criteria: LinkedIn headline signals (People Ops vs. ops/CHRO), company stage, reporting line, apparent risk tolerance

next_actions.label: Validate personas in next discovery calls

args.validation_criteria: persona trait matching, objection patterns, decision driver alignment
